scoring_rule: Full integer weight only for met. Partial and open earn zero. Published evidence audit is distinguished from fresh replay. No points for writing this roadmap.

milestones.current_assessment: There is no all-instanton control of a general nonscalar family in the public record.
milestones.next_action: Derive a multi-instanton recursion or exact physical identity and test the first two new charges independently.
milestones.required_artifact: Charge-two/three checks and an all-order physical family theorem.

milestones.title: The physical BPS sector and loop-order convention are fixed
milestones.scope: Undeformed N4 one-sixteenth-BPS local operators in the repository convention.
acceptance: Identify the physical supercharge, Lorentz/R charges and retained holomorphic derivatives.
Distinguish a spectral-sequence differential order from a dilatation-energy loop order.
State the formal-relative-complex scope whenever a physical operator comparison is not proved.
milestones.current_assessment: The sector and order conventions are documented. This is a dictionary point, not a completed physical composite-operator theorem.
milestones.next_action: Make these fields mandatory in every new claim and physical dataset.
milestones.required_artifact: Theory/charge/order dictionary with explicit formal-to-physical assumptions.

milestones.title: A complete physical block containing fortuitous survivors has its inner product
milestones.scope: One genuine non-Abelian complete physical charge block containing certified fortuitous survivors, selected before computing its metric.
acceptance: Construct physical states obeying the supercharge and radial-adjoint conditions at the stated coupling order.
Compute every two-point matrix entry, all null relations and positivity on the entire physical charge block, retaining all classes and mixed pairings.
Check normalization and basis-change invariance independently; a coefficient dual is not a physical bra.
milestones.current_assessment: The exact fortuitous dual explicitly supplies no Wick metric. Existing half-BPS protection pairings do not fill this gap.
milestones.next_action: Select the smallest complete non-Abelian survivor block and derive its full renormalized two-point matrix.
milestones.required_artifact: Physical representatives, full positive inner product and normalization checks.

milestones.title: The formal differential is matched to physical composite operators
milestones.scope: One full-jet nonscalar N4 source/target sector, then its required local product/current operations.
acceptance: Derive the comparison with renormalized physical local operators, including finite-rank relations and all relevant mixings.
Prove agreement of the differential and matched product/current operations through the first nonzero quantum order, at least third order for the orthogonal benchmark, or by an all-order theorem.
State any remaining hypotheses explicitly; an existence theorem in the formal complex alone does not pass.
milestones.current_assessment: The formal theory is strong, but physical composite/current matching is an explicit remaining gap.
milestones.next_action: Choose one physically normalized channel and derive the local comparison rather than infer it from matching dimensions.
milestones.required_artifact: Physical comparison theorem or complete channel-specific derivation.

milestones.title: One lifted fortuitous class has an explicit recombining multiplet
milestones.scope: One certified positive orthogonal differential; an alternative channel requires an independently certified physical lift first.
acceptance: Identify the complete superconformal parent and every required short-multiplet partner.
Match quantum numbers, operator mixing and the physical norm of the recombination map.
Derive the corresponding energy/order consequence in the same normalization.
milestones.current_assessment: Algebraic differential witnesses are available; a complete physical multiplet reconstruction is not.
milestones.next_action: Solve primary conditions for one certified chain and calculate its partner matrix elements.
milestones.required_artifact: Explicit physical multiplet and normalized recombination calculation.

milestones.title: Quantum products predict lifts beyond undressed classes
milestones.scope: A complete finite set of nonscalar survivor generators and all their products in a frozen charge window.
acceptance: Compute matched quantum products including cross-factor contractions and associativity homotopies where required.
Determine the induced relations and first incoming maps for every product in the window.
Validate three product predictions with independent native calculations; ordinary tree multiplication is insufficient.
milestones.current_assessment: Matched formal product machinery and specific product consequences exist; the complete physically matched product table does not.
milestones.next_action: Build one finite physically matched product table from fully specified generators.
milestones.required_artifact: Complete quantum product table and independent predicted-lift checks.

milestones.title: S-duality makes successful new operator-level predictions
milestones.scope: The SO7/Sp3 pair first, with a prospective common full-charge window.
acceptance: Match complete perturbative survivor multiplicities and charge conventions.
Construct an operator-level or protected-correlator dictionary for the relevant classes, not just an index equality.
Predict and independently verify three previously uncomputed sectors or physical pairings.
milestones.current_assessment: Finite-window second-page dimension agreement is already reported; the stronger operator/correlator predictions are open.
milestones.next_action: Freeze three new sectors and derive their duality predictions before either direct calculation.
milestones.required_artifact: Duality dictionary and held-out prediction/verification records.

milestones.scope: One explicitly selected non-Abelian fortuitous family or complete finite charge block.
acceptance: Construct a precise Hilbert-space/operator correspondence including finite-rank constraints.
Reproduce exact multiplicities and one nontrivial lift/protection decision beyond a signed-index match.
Predict a new block or pairing and verify it with the native algebraic framework.
milestones.current_assessment: No such matched giant-graviton calculation is present in the audited record.
milestones.next_action: Choose one completely certified family and formulate a finite-rank brane quantization problem with testable outputs.
milestones.required_artifact: Explicit dual correspondence, exact match and new verified prediction.

milestones.title: One physical mechanism explains and predicts the observed patterns
milestones.scope: Fortuity, rank dependence, perturbative first-hit orders and at least one physical instanton decision.
acceptance: Derive a common mechanism with clearly stated coupling and large-charge limits.
Explain the complete known positive and negative cases in its declared domain, including exceptional low ranks.
Verify three prospectively recorded predictions and justify any continuation toward the black-hole regime.
milestones.current_assessment: Several exact mechanisms and strong clues exist; a single physically validated predictive account is not established.
milestones.next_action: Compare independently certified patterns only after operator matching, and record falsifiable predictions before calculations.
milestones.required_artifact: Physical derivation, scope limits and held-out tests.

milestones.title: A permitted physical chaos diagnostic is defined
milestones.scope: A complete genuine non-Abelian one-sixteenth-BPS state block at fixed charges.
acceptance: Define directly evaluated physical correlator observables using explicitly constructed states annihilated by the supercharge and its radial adjoint, or an intrinsic cohomology endomorphism; no projection construction or truncated complex.

For direct correlators, establish physical state and mixing independence; for an intrinsic endomorphism, prove descent, charge preservation, Hermiticity, physical simplicity and its connection to the diagnostic. Fix observable normalization in either route.
State the competing chaos hypotheses and the coupling/charge regime before inspecting spectra.
milestones.current_assessment: No public observable specification was found. The degenerate BPS Hamiltonian and an arbitrary coefficient matrix do not supply it.
milestones.next_action: Derive an admissible correlator-based diagnostic; if its assumptions fail, expose the obstruction and revise the question explicitly.
milestones.required_artifact: Physical observable definition and mathematical well-definedness proof.

milestones.title: The chaos-analysis pipeline passes matched controls
milestones.scope: Exactly specified structured and random reference models, plus a protected physical benchmark.
acceptance: Resolve continuous, discrete and antiunitary symmetries before combining any levels.
Validate eigenvalue residuals, precision, null modes and invariance under exact basis changes.
Demonstrate the declared test distinguishes matched-size controls at its preregistered false-positive and power thresholds.
milestones.current_assessment: Classical charge infrastructure exists, but no physical chaos calibration pipeline is public.
milestones.next_action: Freeze reference ensembles, test windows and numerical error bounds before analyzing the target dataset.
milestones.required_artifact: Calibration dataset, exact/controlled numerical checks and test specification.

milestones.title: Two physical probes are fully computed on usable survivor blocks
milestones.scope: The prospectively fixed complete blocks from G01; sample sizes follow the power requirement in G02.
acceptance: Compute the full physical two-point matrix and all entries for two independently defined simple probes.
Include operator renormalization/mixing and every symmetry sector used in the analysis.
Report actual physical multiplicity and distinct-level counts; cochain dimensions and dressed copies are not sample-size substitutes.
milestones.current_assessment: No complete physical probe matrices are public. The one-dimensional omega block has zero adjacent gaps and cannot provide a spacing sample.
milestones.next_action: Generate a complete survivor block large enough for the predeclared test and evaluate both physical observables.
milestones.required_artifact: Two full probe datasets, physical metric and symmetry decomposition.

milestones.title: A finite-block chaos test has reproducible statistical conclusions
milestones.scope: The complete target and control datasets from G02/G03.
acceptance: Run both adjacent-gap statistics and a predeclared long-range correlation diagnostic.
Publish all windows, normalization choices, numerical error bounds, uncertainty and multiple-testing treatment.
A positive, negative or inconclusive outcome must retain its actual label; local repulsion alone is not strong chaos.

Bound uncomputed perturbative and nonperturbative contributions at the spectral scales used by the diagnostic, or restrict the conclusion explicitly to the fixed-rank weak-coupling limit. Numerical eigenvalue accuracy alone does not establish physical spectral accuracy.
milestones.current_assessment: No target spectra or statistical analysis were located in the audited public files.
milestones.next_action: Run the frozen analysis once on the complete dataset and preserve every result, including failed hypotheses.
milestones.required_artifact: Complete analysis code, raw spectra and reproducible statistical report.

milestones.title: Rank, charge and coupling dependence are resolved
milestones.scope: At least three distinct non-Abelian ranks, three growing-charge blocks per rank and both physical probes.
acceptance: Select blocks by a rule fixed before observing chaos statistics; do not pool incompatible symmetries.
Distinguish the stated competing size/coupling scalings by analytic bounds or a quantitatively justified inference with uncertainty.
Separate a finite-data conclusion from an asymptotic theorem; three ranks alone cannot prove a large-rank law.

Control omitted perturbative and nonperturbative effects at the measured spectral scales. A simultaneous large-rank, finite-coupling claim requires a bound uniform in rank; fixed-rank weak-coupling evidence cannot supply it.
milestones.current_assessment: There is no growing physical chaos dataset, and no controlled continuation from weak coupling to the black-hole regime.
milestones.next_action: Extend the same normalized physical observable along the frozen rank/charge sequence.
milestones.required_artifact: Scaling dataset, controlled inference or theorem, and explicit limits.

milestones.scope: Complete physical blocks containing classified fortuitous and monotone states, with controlled rank or coupling variation.
acceptance: Compare complete physical charge/symmetry blocks using matched-size statistical controls and consistent normalization. Retain all mixed matrix elements unless the observable is proved to preserve a finer decomposition.

Track a certified lift or disappearance, record other simultaneous changes in the theory, and prospectively predict and independently verify observable changes; rank/coupling variation alone is not a causal identification of fortuity.
Establish the proposed connection in a declared regime or rigorously delimit its failure. Do not identify a black-hole microstate from fortuity alone.
milestones.current_assessment: The connection is motivated by primary literature, but no repository calculation tests it physically.
milestones.next_action: Choose a rank/coupling transition with known state fate and derive its observable prediction before measurement.
milestones.required_artifact: Matched-sector experiment and physically justified fortuity/lift/chaos conclusion.
